name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council repealing Regulation (EU) No 524/2013, and amending Regulations (EU) 2017/2394 and (EU) 2018/1724 with regard to the discontinuation of the European Online Dispute Resolution Platform
part_text:
The European Union is shutting down its online platform for resolving disputes between shoppers and traders. The platform was set up in 2013 to help people settle complaints about online purchases out of court. This report approves the Council's position to close it and to remove the related references from two other consumer protection laws. Parliament made no changes, so the closure can go ahead quickly.

- The European Online Dispute Resolution Platform is closed and the 2013 law that created it is repealed.
- It affects shoppers and traders who used the platform for online purchase complaints.
- Parliament approved the text unchanged, so the regulation can be adopted and enter into force.
